failures.failure: PowerShell rejected a direct foreach-to-pipeline metadata expression.
failures.recovery: Materialize the loop result in an array before JSON serialization.
failures.recurrence_guard: Materialize the loop result in an array before JSON serialization.

failures.failure: The first whole-file recovery-commons HTML display exceeded its result budget.
failures.recovery: Read all contract modules separately and parse the embedded frozen JSON plus structural boundaries without displaying the payload.
failures.recurrence_guard: Read all contract modules separately and parse the embedded frozen JSON plus structural boundaries without displaying the payload.

failures.failure: A combined lane preflight embedded a Git command and LASTEXITCODE inside an object expression and failed to parse.
failures.recovery: Run the Git ancestry probe separately, then project the captured scalar.
failures.recurrence_guard: Run the Git ancestry probe separately, then project the captured scalar.

failures.failure: The Elowen clone did not contain Saelin's cross-owner commit object, so the attempted ancestry query was invalid.
failures.recovery: Use Saelin's verified worktree for source truth and record content provenance rather than fabricated cross-owner ancestry.
failures.recurrence_guard: Use Saelin's verified worktree for source truth and record content provenance rather than fabricated cross-owner ancestry.

failures.failure: The composite no-checkout worktree creation wrapper crossed its output boundary after reporting only preparation.
failures.recovery: Audit target, processes, locks, branch and index before any retry; do not recreate or kill the worktree.
failures.recurrence_guard: Audit target, processes, locks, branch and index before any retry; do not recreate or kill the worktree.

failures.failure: The first worktree audit called Trim on a null branch result while the orphan switch was still active.
failures.recovery: Read raw command values and exit codes without assuming a branch string.
failures.recurrence_guard: Read raw command values and exit codes without assuming a branch string.

failures.failure: The second combined worktree audit returned no attributable payload while Git processes remained active.
failures.recovery: Inspect process state separately, wait once for exact processes, then read Git scalars after quiescence.
failures.recurrence_guard: Inspect process state separately, wait once for exact processes, then read Git scalars after quiescence.

failures.failure: An inline Node regular-expression was malformed by shell quoting during HTML frozen-data extraction.
failures.recovery: Use delimiter-based extraction in a single-quoted Node command.
failures.recurrence_guard: Use delimiter-based extraction in a single-quoted Node command.

failures.failure: The first Saelin proposal-freeze probe assumed a proposals field although the exact schema uses requests.
failures.recovery: Inspect top-level type and keys first, then select the exact requests array.
failures.recurrence_guard: Inspect top-level type and keys first, then select the exact requests array.

failures.failure: Node 24 refused a direct syntax check of the required .txt entrypoint because it could not infer a module format.
failures.recovery: Feed the exact entrypoint bytes to Node with an explicit CommonJS input type for syntax validation.
failures.recurrence_guard: Feed the exact entrypoint bytes to Node with an explicit CommonJS input type for syntax validation.

failures.failure: The first planning execution rejected repeated proposal-definition digests without identifying the colliding records.
failures.recovery: Add a deterministic digest-group diagnostic while preserving the distinctness stop.
failures.recurrence_guard: Add a deterministic digest-group diagnostic while preserving the distinctness stop.

failures.failure: A read-only inline duplicate-diagnostic wrapper was parsed by PowerShell before Node and failed before execution.
failures.recovery: Use apply_patch to add the recurrence diagnostic without shell quoting or repository-wide mutation.
failures.recurrence_guard: Use apply_patch to add the recurrence diagnostic without shell quoting or repository-wide mutation.

failures.failure: The diagnostic planning attempt isolated three record-order cases with an identical duplicate fixture.
failures.recovery: Retain the duplicate-record scenario while varying its synthetic identifier by case so all proposal inputs remain distinct.
failures.recurrence_guard: Retain the duplicate-record scenario while varying its synthetic identifier by case so all proposal inputs remain distinct.

failures.failure: The first materialized planning candidate exposed two exact definition-digest collisions with Saelin source authority-gate fixtures.
failures.recovery: Replace those actions with sequence-record-specific gated actions and make zero source title or definition collisions a hard pre-write gate.
failures.recurrence_guard: Replace those actions with sequence-record-specific gated actions and make zero source title or definition collisions a hard pre-write gate.

failures.failure: The first planning audit projected stale guessed approval, skill, and runner filenames and reported false zero counts.
failures.recovery: List exact generated filenames and inspect their top-level keys before selecting records.
failures.recurrence_guard: List exact generated filenames and inspect their top-level keys before selecting records.

failures.failure: The corrected filename audit still projected local skills and runners as flat arrays although the plan groups them by x1 and x2.
failures.recovery: Inspect the exact nested schema and count local_skills.x1, local_skills.x2, local_runners.x1, and local_runners.x2.
failures.recurrence_guard: Inspect the exact nested schema and count local_skills.x1, local_skills.x2, local_runners.x1, and local_runners.x2.

failures.failure: The first exact planning manifest replay found scope-review bytes changed after their digest was recorded.
failures.recovery: Write the scope review first and the self-excluding exact-byte manifest last.
failures.recurrence_guard: Write the scope review first and the self-excluding exact-byte manifest last.

failures.failure: The first private-path scanner pattern also matched the final drive-like characters of HTTPS URLs.
failures.recovery: Require a standalone drive prefix so scheme text cannot be classified as a private absolute path.
failures.recurrence_guard: Require a standalone drive prefix so scheme text cannot be classified as a private absolute path.

failures.failure: The first media-candidate adjudication filter recognized the JSON false field but missed the equivalent inline builder policy field.
failures.recovery: Classify every new_screenshots false occurrence as scanner-definition or policy metadata before counting confirmed payload hits.
failures.recurrence_guard: Classify every new_screenshots false occurrence as scanner-definition or policy metadata before counting confirmed payload hits.
